name: CAN Bus Off
description: CAN controller enters bus-off state due to excessive transmission errors on the network.
detectionStep: CanSM detects bus-off via CanIf controller status
recovery: CanSM initiates bus-off recovery sequence: STOP → START after 128 occurrences of 11 idle bits
fallbackMode: Degraded mode — affected functions unavailable until recovery

name: Checksum Error
description: Received CAN frame fails CRC verification indicating corrupted data.
detectionStep: CAN controller hardware rejects frame with bad CRC
demAction: Error counter incremented, DEM logs communication error
recovery: Frame discarded, sender retransmits on next cycle
fallbackMode: Use last valid received value with timeout monitoring

name: Signal Timeout
description: Expected cyclic CAN message not received within configured timeout period.
detectionStep: COM monitors receive timeout for each signal
demAction: DEM logs DTC for lost communication with specific ECU
recovery: COM sets signal to invalid/default value, SWC uses fallback logic
warningLamp: Relevant warning depending on lost signal
fallbackMode: Feature degraded — e.g., manual window operation if BCM timeout

name: Battery Low
description: Supply voltage drops below minimum operating threshold.
detectionStep: BCM voltage monitoring SWC detects Vbat < 9V
recovery: EcuM initiates controlled shutdown, non-critical functions disabled
fallbackMode: Load shedding — comfort functions disabled first

name: LIN Bus Failure
description: LIN bus communication failure between BCM master and door slave.
detectionStep: LinIf detects missing slave response in schedule table
recovery: LinIf retries 3 times, then marks slave as failed
fallbackMode: Door functions unavailable for affected LIN segment

name: Gateway Failure
description: Gateway ECU fails to route messages between network domains.
detectionStep: Multiple ECUs report lost communication simultaneously
demAction: DEM logs U0100 across multiple ECUs
recovery: Gateway watchdog reset, routing table reload from NvM

name: Sensor Failure
description: Sensor provides implausible or out-of-range values.
detectionStep: SWC plausibility check detects invalid sensor reading
recovery: SWC substitutes estimated value or disables feature
fallbackMode: Feature disabled or operating with reduced accuracy

name: Motor Failure
description: Actuator motor fails to respond or stalls during operation.
detectionStep: Current sense detects stall condition or no position change
recovery: Motor driver disabled, anti-pinch triggered if during movement

name: ECU Reset
description: ECU undergoes unexpected reset due to software fault or watchdog.
detectionStep: EcuM boot reason register indicates unexpected reset
demAction: DEM logs internal ECU fault DTC on next boot
recovery: ECU reboots, re-initializes all BSW modules, resumes operation

name: Fuse Blown
description: Supply fuse for actuator circuit has failed.
detectionStep: No current flow detected when actuator commanded ON
recovery: Feature disabled until fuse replaced (service required)

name: Wire Cut
description: Communication or power wire physically severed.
detectionStep: Open circuit detected on LIN or CAN line
demAction: DEM logs communication or actuator circuit DTC
recovery: Requires physical repair — no software recovery

name: Short to Ground
description: Wire insulation damaged causing short circuit to ground.
detectionStep: Overcurrent protection triggers on affected circuit
recovery: Circuit protection disables output until fault cleared

name: Watchdog Reset
description: Internal watchdog timer expires indicating software hang.
detectionStep: Watchdog module triggers ECU reset when not fed within timeout
demAction: DEM logs watchdog reset reason on next boot
recovery: ECU reboots automatically, DEM captures reset reason in NvM

name: Application Crash
description: Application SWC encounters unhandled exception causing system fault.
detectionStep: OS protection hook catches memory violation or stack overflow
demAction: DEM logs software fault DTC with crash dump in NvM
recovery: OS resets affected task or triggers ECU reset via EcuM

name: AUTOSAR Stack Timeout
description: BSW module fails to complete operation within deadline.
detectionStep: Watchdog or deadline monitoring detects BSW timeout
demAction: DEM logs BSW fault, DET reports development error
recovery: BSW module reset, operation retried once
